insights.title: Generative AI Is Entering Every Business Workflow
insights.text: From drafting documents to writing code, generative AI is becoming a daily co-worker. Companies that embed it into real workflows - not just chat windows - are seeing 30-50% productivity gains.

insights.title: AI Agents Are Becoming the New Digital Workforce
insights.text: The next wave beyond chatbots: autonomous agents that read emails, reconcile data, and complete multi-step tasks across your tools - with human approval where it matters.

insights.title: Computer Vision Moves to the Factory Floor
insights.text: Cameras you already own can now inspect every unit on the line, enforce safety compliance, and count retail footfall - AI turns CCTV into a 24/7 operations team.

insights.title: Cloud-Native Is Now the Default, Not the Upgrade
insights.text: Auto-scaling infrastructure, one-click rollbacks, and deploy pipelines that run themselves - modern teams ship daily because their platform absorbs the risk.

insights.title: Your Data Wants to Talk - In Plain English
insights.text: Natural-language analytics lets any manager type a question and get a live chart. The gap between 'we have data' and 'we use data' is finally closing.

insights.title: Voice and Vernacular Interfaces Go Mainstream
insights.text: The next billion users prefer speaking to typing - in their own language. Voice AI in English and Tamil is opening digital services to entirely new audiences.
